desc.en: Ziyarat of Ummul Baneen (s), Mother of Hazrat Abbas (a). The name of Ummul Baneen is Fatema, the daughter of Hezaam. She was an extremely righteous, valiant, religious, accomplished and sincere lady. After the martyrdom of Hazrat Fatema Zahra (s), she became the wife of Hazrat Ali (a). She gave birth to 4 sons Abbas, Abdullah, Jafar and Usmaan. All of them fought on the side of Imam Husain (a) and achieved martyrdom. Ummul Baneen used to mourn on her 4 sons and other martyrs of Karbala. She also composed Marsiyas (Poems of sorrow) in their honour and thus she was the one who has kept the memory of Karbala alive. Recite the Ziyarat of Ummul Baneen (s) as follows…
desc.rurdu: Ummul Baneen (s) ki ziyarat jo Hazrat Abbas (a) ki waaleda hai. Dar haqeeqat Ummul Baneen ka naam Fatema binte Hezaam hai. Woh ek behtareen muttaqi aur parhez-gaar bibi thi. Hazrat Fatima Zahra (s) ki shahadat ke baad, Ummul Baneen, Hazrat Ali (a) ki biwi bani. Unse 4 awlaad huwi, Abbas, Abdullah, Jafar aur Usmaan. Inki sabhi aulaado’n ne Imam Husain (a) ki nusrat karte huwe Karbala mein shaheed huwe. Unho ne Karbala par marsiya bhi likkha aur is tarah unho ne Karbala ki yaad ko zindah rakkha. Ummul Baneen (s) ki ziyarat is tarah se hai…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الطَّيِّبَةُ الطَّاهِرَةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الصَّابِرَةُ الشَّاكِرَةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الْعَالِمَةُ الْعَامِلَةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الْفَاضِلَةُ الزَّكِيَّةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا التَّقِيَّةُ النَّقِيَّةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الرَّضِيَّةُ الْمَرْضِيَّةُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَازَوْجَةَ وَلِيِّ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَاحَلِيْلَةَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ۔  اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَااُمَّ الْبَنِيْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَااُمَّ الْعَبَّاسِّ بْنِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلٰى اَوْلَادِكِ الْاَرْبَعَةِ الْمُسْتَشْهِدِيْنَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْاِمَامِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَوْمَ عَاشُوْرَآء۔ رِضْوَانُ اللهِ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْكِ ، وَجَعَلَ اللهُ اَعَالِيَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلَكِ وَمَأوَاكِ۔ يَاوَجِيْهَةً عِنْدَ اللهِ اِشْفَعِيْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وّآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAT TAIYYE-BA-TUT TAAHE-RA-TO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAS SAABE-RA-TUSH SHAAKE-RA-TO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAL AA’ME-LATO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAL FAAZE-LA-TUZ ZAKIYYA-TO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAT TAQIYYA-TUN NAQIYYA-TO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE AYYA-TO-HAR RAZIYYA-TUL MARZIYYA-TO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE YAA ZAWJA-TA WALIYYIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE YAA HA-LEELA-TA AMEERIL MO-MENEENA. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE YAA UMMAL BANEENA. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE YAA UMMUL A’BBAA-SIB-NE AMEERIL MO-MENEENA A’LAI-HIS SALAAMO. AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKE WA A’LAA AW-LAADE-KIL ARBA-A’TIL MUS-TASHHE-DEENA BAIYNA YA-DAL IMAAMIL HUSAINE A’LAI-HIS SALAAMO YAWMA AA’SHOO-RAAA-E. RIZWAA-NUL LAAHE TA-AA’LAA A’LAIKE, WAJA-A’LAL LAAHO A-AA’LE-YAL JANNATE MANZE-LA-KE WA MAAWA-KE. YAA WAJEE-HATAN I’NDAL LAAHE ISHFA-EE’ LANAA I’NDAL LAAHE WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HIT TAIYYE-BEE-NAT TAAHE-REENA.

trans.en: Peace be on you, the pure purified, Peace be on you, O the Patient & Thankful. Peace be on you O the Knowledgeable & who acted on the knowledge. Peace be on you O Honored (Fazila) & Purified (Zakiya). Peace be upon you O Pious (Taqiya) & Naqia. Peace be upon you O Razia & Marziya (Pleased with HIS decree). Peace be upon you the wife of the Viceregent of Allah. Peace be upon you o companion of Ameer ul Momineen. Peace be on you, O Ummul Baneen. Peace be on you, the mother of Abbas, son of Amir al-Mu’mineen, Ali ibn Abu Talib. Peace be upon you & your four sons who sacrificed their lives on Imam Hussain (as) on the day of Ashura. May Allah be pleased with you and make Heaven your home and resting place, with God’s mercy and blessings. O intimate of Allah, stand by us when Allah sits in judgment over us.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
